browserWithinFullGate.scope: Actual signed-in application with synthetic OAuth consent and provider replies. No real music provider, physical playback, or production writes.
checks: Direct account connection appears before file imports and requires no live room or CSV
Provider consent cancellation returns useful feedback without attaching an account
Actual OAuth callback validates PKCE and saves encrypted account credentials through the normal signed-in route
Selecting a currently available player persists the target without starting audio; restricted devices stay disabled
Accepted Play command does not fabricate Playing before a separately observed provider response
Play, pause, resume, queue and next use the selected external player and display only reported track/state
Provider playlist edit appears automatically without uploading files or overwriting a saved request list
Search and saved songs are read from the connected account
Lost command outcome disables controls until manual verification and never automatically resends
Unavailable playback feedback removes control permission and supports explicit recovery
Connected account, music browsing and player controls fit desktop and narrow mobile screens
A separate real account and a cross-origin mutation cannot use another account’s connection
Only the authenticated connection owner can operate the player; anonymous and foreign-account commands never reach the source
Authenticated connection and selected device survive actual server restart and browser reload
Cross-tab reconnect clears previous playback, library and devices until current authorization reads succeed, without autoplay
Late old-authorization search rejection cannot revoke or overwrite the reconnected account
Confirmed disconnect deletes authorization and command records without deleting request libraries; cancel preserves access
Absent provider approval cannot be mistaken for a working connection or enabled by a user checkbox

operatorBoundary.scope: Actual application sessions/HTTP/database; provider simulated. Forged approval/payment fields are not real paid-request or webhook tests.

scope: Actual local Sway application sessions, HTTP and owned embedded PostgreSQL with simulated provider consent/API. No real-provider approval, physical playback, standalone database concurrency, main merge or production deployment proved.
remainingAcceptance: Provider-approved real account and physical device/playback verification
Separate production merge/deploy authority and exact-release acceptance
resume: Resume from this tested candidate or a docs-only descendant. Do not rerun the same full gate unless runtime/test/dependency changes invalidate it. Preserve historical failed attempts.
